29627.d: White Wolf Mountain is a natural region between Taverley and Catherby, and as a border between the kingdoms of Asgarnia and Kandarin.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
To traverse the exterior of the mountain:
• Travel via the Gnome glider network to the Sindarpos location, which takes you to the east of the cave that leads to Catherby as well as a Hidey-hole location for one of the Treasure trail (hard) emote clues. Completion of The Grand Tree quest is required to use the gliders. To reach the cave entrance that leads back to Taverley, run north.
• Home Teleport to the Taverley lodestone then run south and then north around the bank. Follow the path past the Land of Snow portal (used in the Violet is Blue quest) to your west until your reach a cave entrance. Entering the cave at the end of the path will take you to the area with wolves, Gnome glider, and cave entrance to Catherby.
• Home teleport to the Catherby lodestone then run east past the fishing area on the beach then north. Follow that path to the cave entrance that will take you to the area with wolves, Gnome glider, and cave entrance to Taverley.

To traverse the interior of the mountain (requires completion of Fishing Contest quest):
• To go from Taverley to Catherby: Enter the cave entrance directly to the north of the Taverley Player-owned house portal. Following the underground passage will lead to a cave exit just east of the Catherby farming patch.
• To go from Catherby to Taverley: Enter the cave entrance to the east of the Catherby farming patch. Follow the underground path which exits just north of the Taverley Player-owned house portal.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'White Wolf Mountain'

29667.d: The Wilderness (level 14) volcano mine is located to the south-east of the Wilderness Crater and north-east of the level 13 Wilderness Obelisk.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Wilderness (level 14) volcano mine'

29668.d: The Wilderness (level 35) hobgoblin mine, is a mine found in the Wilderness from levels 45 to 50.
29668.loc: North of Bandit Camp, north-west of Wilderness Crater

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
• Wilderness Crater lodestone, run far north
• Using Wilderness obelisks to reach the level 44 obelisk, travel south-east
• Use the Herb Patch teleport option of the Wilderness sword 1 or higher, then travel west.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Wilderness (level 35) hobgoblin mine'

29669.d: The Wilderness (level 47) Lava Maze mine, also called the Wilderness phasmatite mine, is located north of both the Wilderness (level 35) hobgoblin mine and the Lava Maze in the Wilderness.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
• Wilderness obelisks, stopping at the level 44 obelisk and running east
• Wilderness sword 4 to the Wilderness Agility Course and running south then south-east (m) 
• Lava titan teleport to the Lava Maze and running north.(m) 
• Slayer cape teleport to Mandrith and run south-west through the gate.(m)

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Wilderness (level 47) Lava Maze mine'

29670.d: The Wilderness (level 54) Pirates' Hideout mine is a mine located east of the Pirates' Hideout in the deep Wilderness.
29670.loc: East of Pirates' Hideout, level 53 Wilderness

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
• Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Mandrith, who is very close to the mine.
• Wilderness sword 4 teleport to Wilderness Agility Course, then run northeast.
• Pull the lever in East Ardougne or Edgeville to teleport to Deserted Keep, run north, then west.
• Obelisk (Wilderness) to level 44 Wilderness, north through the gate, then northeast.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Wilderness (level 54) Pirates' Hideout mine'

29671.loc: At the point where the River Lum enters a tunnel

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
• Edgeville lodestone, run north
• Wilderness sword 1, teleport to Edgeville, run north
• Amulet of glory and its variants, teleport to Edgeville, run north

29672.d: The Wilderness (level 9) south-west mine, also known as the Wilderness Skeleton mine, is located in level 12-14 Wilderness, just north of the Black Knights' Fortress and south of the Dark Warriors' Fortress.

gt.heading: Travel
gt.text:
• Chaos altar teleport, then west
• Wilderness Crater lodestone, then southwest
• Wilderness sword 2 to Forinthry Dungeon, then south-west

29677.d: The Wilderness Agility Course is an Agility course which requires level 52 Agility to access the course by opening the gate to cross the ridge which gives 15 Agility experience.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The Wilderness sword 4 provides unlimited teleports to the course after all Wilderness achievements have been completed.
• Players can use Ghorrock Teleport (Ancient Magick with level 96 Magic) or Ice Plateau Teleport (lunar spell with level 89 Magic) to teleport themselves due west of the course.
• Pull the Ardougne or Edgeville teleport lever to Deserted Keep, cut through an unavoidable spider web to the north, head west to the north side of the Mage Arena, and then continue to the south-west, past the hellhounds and some acheron mammoths.
• There is an Wilderness obelisk on level 44 south of the course.

29680.d: The Wilderness Crater (formerly known as the Wilderness Volcano and the Bounty Hunter crater) is a large crater situated in the centre of the Wilderness.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The fastest way to access the crater is using the Wilderness Crater lodestone. 
• Take a canoe to the Wilderness pond then run south and use one of the northern entrances to the crater.
• Teleport to the level 35 obelisk using the obelisk network or a portable obelisk.
• Use the Earth altar teleport, Varrock Teleport spell or the Edgeville lodestone, running through the Wilderness and using the southeastern entrance of the crater.
• Use the Wilderness sword 4, teleport to the herb patch and run south.

Regardless of the method of travel, players opted into PvP may be attacked by player killers while in the Wilderness.
